line: if [ -n "${HTTPS_PROXY:-}" ]; then a=${HTTPS_PROXY#*://}; a=${a%%/*}; h=${a%:*}; p=${a##*:}; export JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="${JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS:-} -Duser.home=$HOME -Dhttps.proxyHost=$h -Dhttps.proxyPort=$p -Dhttp.proxyHost=$h -Dhttp.proxyPort=$p"; mkdir -p "$HOME/.m2"; printf "%s\n" "<settings><proxies>" "<proxy><id>https</id><protocol>https</protocol><host>$h</host><port>$p</port></proxy>" "<proxy><id>http</id><protocol>http</protocol><host>$h</host><port>$p</port></proxy>" "</proxies></settings>" > "$HOME/.m2/settings.xml"; fi; for f in 'good' 'bad'; do ( cd "$f" && gradle --no-daemon --console=plain -q dependencies ) > /tmp/daodan-restore.log 2>&1 && ! grep -Eq ' FAILED$' /tmp/daodan-restore.log || { printf 'DAODAN-RESTORE-FAILED gradle %s\n' "$f"; { grep -E ' FAILED$|What went wrong|Could not ' /tmp/daodan-restore.log || tail -n 30 /tmp/daodan-restore.log; } | head -n 30; echo DAODAN-RESTORE-END; } >&2; done; true
